findings.motion: HB 1096 Various elections matters, introduced and referred to Elections and Apportionment (first author Prescott)
findings.note: Introduced bill on various election matters. Its digest covers party affiliation at registration and primary voting, a provisional-ballot affidavit naming party, a ban on handing out absentee ballot applications unless the voter or certain family members asked for one (with a civil penalty up to $100), and a shorter in-person absentee period. The digest does not add a photo-ID or proof-of-citizenship rule.

HB 1232, short title 'Right to carry a handgun'. Prescott is listed as author (coauthors Mayfield, Torr, May). Summary: 'Repeals the law that requires a person to obtain a license to carry a handgun in Indiana.' Action line dated Jan 14, 2021: 'Authored by Representative Prescott'. Per LegiScan snippet it died in committee. Source is a third-party mirror, not iga.in.gov (which could not be read). Orchestrator check 2026-11-03: the LegiScan IN 2021 bulk set lists John Prescott as primary sponsor (type 1) of HB1232, coauthors Mayfield, Torr, May; url set to the official bill page (LegiScan state_link).
